text.tspan: Host kernel/ABI, target visibility and permissions
Header/stub and published source are not runtime proof
Bounded frames, per-CPU epochs and persistence
No target wrapper, extra fd or process-control API
Retain partial local facts without invented joins
V1-V9 remain open; no Scheme commit from syscall alone
No E-row/native retirement or performance claim
DESIGN ONLY. No probe enumeration, consumer build, trace or fixture run.
The observer is a version-bound evidence adapter, outside normal product builds.
Earlier libc setup errors remain separate
Exact lengths/chunks, bounds and copy outcomes
Spawn kernel actions need their own witness
